candidates.change_summary: Remove the owner-only require check so any caller can trigger the transfer.
Transfer to msg.sender instead of the receiver parameter.
Transfer a fixed amount of 1 wei instead of the given amount.
Delete the require(msg.sender == owner) access-control statement so any caller can trigger the transfer.
Change the ownership check to require(msg.sender != owner), inverting who is authorized.
Redirect the payout to msg.sender instead of the receiver parameter.
Transfer 0 instead of the requested amount, so no value is ever sent.
Remove the require(msg.sender == owner) check so anyone can call sendTo.
Invert the ownership check so only non-owners can trigger the transfer.
Replace transfer with send, ignoring its return value so failed transfers no longer revert.
Remove the require(msg.sender == owner) access control check so any caller can transfer funds.
Replace the owner check with a tx.origin check, allowing calls from contracts initiated by the owner to bypass the restriction.
Removed the require(msg.sender == owner) access control check so any caller can trigger the transfer.
Removed the transfer statement so no Ether is sent and the call no longer affects the receiver's balance.
Changed the transfer amount from `amount` to 0 so the transferred value no longer matches the requested amount.
Delete the require(msg.sender == owner) check so anyone can call sendTo.
Invert the ownership check so only non-owners can trigger the transfer.
Replace msg.sender with tx.origin in the authorization check.
Delete the transfer statement so no ether is sent.
Send the contract's entire balance instead of the requested amount.
Delete the ownership check require(msg.sender == owner), allowing any caller to trigger the transfer.
Replace the transfer with a low-level call so the send no longer reverts on failure and forwards all available gas.
Replace the transferred amount with the contract's entire balance, sending address(this).balance instead of amount.
Remove the owner check so any address can trigger the transfer.
Change the owner check to require msg.sender == receiver instead.
Replace the state-changing external call with a staticcall that does not transfer value.
Transfer to owner instead of receiver.
Transfer 0 instead of amount.
